chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hasan, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, from Muthanna ibn al-Walid, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

He was asked about a man who bequeathed to a man his children and their wealth, and permitted him at the time of the bequest to conduct business with the wealth and that the profit would be between him and them. So he (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem with it, because the father had permitted him in that regard while he was alive.
ai.seo_question: Can a guardian invest an orphan's wealth in business and share the profits?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the permissibility of investing orphan's wealth in trade (tijarah) with profit-sharing, contingent upon the father's explicit permission during his lifetime. It highlights the Shia juristic principle that the guardian's authority extends to commercial management of assets, distinguishing it from mere preservation, and underscores the importance of the father's consent as the foundational legal basis for this financial arrangement.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Yusuf, from Masny Bin Al Waleed, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having been asked about a man who bequeathed to a man about his children and his wealth for him, and permitted it for him in the bequest that he can do some business with the wealth, and if there happens to be profit, it would be between him and them’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No problem with it, due to the reason that his father had permitted him with regards to that and he was alive (at the time)’.
en.sarwar: 19. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn al-Hassan from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf from Muthanna’ ibn al-Walid from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “Once abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

was asked about the case of a man who made a will about certain assets for his son and gave him permission at the time of his death to use the assets in business and share the profit. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful because his father gave permission when he was living.’”
